verdict.rationale: Beamer clearly applies to this axis, since it collects comments, reactions, NPS responses and feedback inside an app. However, no evidence item documents passing a logged-in user's identity (such as a user ID or email in the embed) so that submitted feedback links to their existing account. Segmentation by user attributes is a separate targeting feature, and it does not show that feedback submissions are tied to identified users.

support.subject: As a developer, I can identify logged-in users when they submit feedback so it ties to their existing account
